notes:
All 40 people in chunk 3 are Georgia Tech ISyE faculty, and all 40 are reviewed in the draft: 30 verified, 10 unresolved, none reached-but-skipped. The draft passes the node check (ids from the chunk, no duplicates, names exact, required fields present, evidenceUrl in sources, and a resolution field wherever the year or institution differs from the chunk). All 10 WebSearch calls were used. I wrote nothing outside the draft and my scratch directory, and ran no git; git status shows no tracked changes. Downloads (profiles, CVs, ORCID JSON) are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-opsphdplacements/fb1f924e-51bf-54c0-8876-48cae82f06a9/scratchpad/fj-3/, and helper scripts in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-opsphdplacements/fb1f924e-51bf-54c0-8876-48cae82f06a9/scratchpad/scripts/.

How evidence was read: the ISyE profiles answered plain curl requests. Most verified records rest on dated CVs linked from those profiles or from the person's own site. Lan and Meel rest on ORCID records read through pub.orcid.org v3.0, and their education entries match the profiles. Benaben's site and Ziani's CV both timed out on the first curl and loaded on the second try. Garcia's site is drawn by script, so I read his CV path from the site's JavaScript bundle. Dahan's CV is the Dropbox file his site links to. The Gebraeel and McGinnis news items were read through Georgia Tech's news-system XML view.

ORCID gives the PhD end as December 2003, so the Purdue post may have begun just before conferral.

3. Jarvis: Georgia Tech 1968 from the INFORMS profile plus the ISyE profile. Rank is not stated, so category is unknown.

6. Kastner: held a Cornell visiting instructor role at the same time as his 2022-23 Cornell postdoc. The postdoc is recorded as the first job.
7. Industry-hosted postdocs are categorised postdoc: Keskinocak (IBM Watson, 1997) and Singh (Microsoft Research New England, 2008). Scheinberg (IBM research staff member, 1997) is categorised industry.
8. Blanchard has a resolution note that MIT and Massachusetts Institute of Technology are the same institution.

McGinnis (the retirement notice's "forty years of service" to December 2011 suggests his Georgia Tech service began before his 1975 PhD). Moghaddam (the GE-Purdue postdoc is undated and not ordered against Northeastern). Lei Xu (the research scientist post at the Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data is undated; her GTSI faculty page failed DNS lookup). Sokol (no chronology; his ORCID record is empty). Tokol-Goldsman (earlier employers listed without dates or order). Moug, Guan and Yousefi Zowj (no dated chronology anywhere).
